Overview Features

A Timeless Home in the Heart of Oranjezicht!

Web Ref. RL1402
Land size 654.00 m²
Floor size 131.00 m²
Monthly Bond Repayment
R164,732.68
Quay 1 International is excited to bring you this brand new exclusive listing high up in sought after Oranjezicht!
Price includes VAT, no transfer duty applicable.

ON SHOW: Tuesday 11:45am to 12:15pm

Beautifully restored and filled with character, this exceptional home is ready to welcome its next owners. Original features have been thoughtfully retained throughout, creating a wonderful balance between timeless charm and modern-day living, while still leaving scope for the new owners to add their own personal touch.

The home offers three generous bedrooms and two-and-a-half bathrooms, complemented by spacious living and entertainment areas designed for effortless everyday living. Outdoors, a private garden and swimming pool create the perfect setting for relaxed afternoons, entertaining friends, and enjoying Cape Town’s enviable lifestyle.

Positioned in an incredible location, the property enjoys beautiful outlooks across the city, Lion’s Head and Table Mountain. A special home combining character, space and views in a setting that is difficult to beat.
Monthly Rates R6,100

Offer Rules
You will be notified of other offers via email.

All sales are non-suspensive and sold as is "voetstoots". Properties on sale with a "Offers From" price will be sold subject to confirmation of the seller. Igcisa Investment Holdings Pty Ltd shall have the right to withdraw any property prior to the offer ending for any reason whatsoever at their discretion.
